correctness.rationale: The Euclidean inner-product shells are 2,4,6,8; the first flag stage is the star nerve of the crown double cover of K_n, giving H1 rank n(n-3)+1. The second is carried by an equivariant rectangular closure to the face poset of the type-A root-polytope boundary S^{n-2}. The third is exactly a cross-polytope boundary S^{binom(n,2)-1}. Cellular fixed-point traces yield f^2-3f+1 and 1-2t. Over Q the tau-even graph cycles are wedge^2 U_n and tau-odd cycles the Specht (n-2,2) kernel. The primitive inclusion L^+ into L identifies the eigensublattice quotient with the image of 1+tau on L/2L; its kernel is the mod-two K_n cycle space, giving dimension binom(n,2)-n and quotient (Z/2)^{n(n-3)/2}. Exact reproduction checks n=4..12; no finite-range claim is used to prove arbitrary rank.

value.rationale: The full type-A root set is a canonical geometric family in every dimension, and the closed-form five-stage Euclidean Rips homotopy/persistence classification identifies the precise geometry where the familiar Hom sphere appears and where the high-dimensional antipodal sphere takes over. The uniform equivariant first-scale calculation supplies explicit full S_n x C2 traces and two rational Specht-type summands. The exact integral obstruction (Z/2)^{n(n-3)/2} demonstrates an essential distinction between rational diagonalization and integral cycle generators that grows rapidly with n. These structural data are mathematically motivated and not a handpicked tiny finite invariant; classical cover/Prym ideas could nevertheless reduce the isolated index contribution.
